dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A forward-analysis certificate for a run and a pair of square real matrices MR and MRinv. Through its constructor it packages spectral quantities, zero-preserving perturbation-propagation maps, an error decomposition, first-order component bounds, and a second-order remainder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For each inverse pair MR, MRinv, execution supplies such a certificate. The target extracts its quantities field to form the time-dependent first-order coefficient in the final error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The first field of a LocalDef001 certificate, namely its LocalDef039 spectral-quantities certificate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects analysis.quantities, whose certified minimum singular value enters LocalDef023 and hence the right-hand side of the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef003 n is the type of n by n real matrices, represented as functions Fin n -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the dimensions and scalar field of MR, MRinv and all square matrices stored in the run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The keyDimension natural-number field of a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The existential witness k is required to equal this stored dimension.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The polynomialFactor descriptor stored in a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the nonnegative-coefficient bivariate polynomial evaluated at n and k in the final multiplicative bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run's time-dependent matrix vHat(t), of dimension n by keyDimension.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its associated spectrum is constrained eventually by the two inequalities involving 4/3.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run's certified spectrum object for vHat(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its sigmaMin and sigmaMax fields are exactly the quantities appearing in the target's eventual spectral bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exact n-dimensional solution vector xExact stored in the run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the reference vector in the relative forward error and its Euclidean norm is the denominator.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The time-dependent computed n-dimensional solution vector xHat(t) stored in the run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is compared with xExact in the relative forward error on the left-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The sigmaMax field of a certified spectrum object.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It produces sigma_max(vHat(t)), which must eventually be at most 4/3.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The sigmaMin field of a certified spectrum object.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It produces sigma_min(vHat(t)) in the eventual reciprocal bound and sigma_min(MR V(t)) in the first-order coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: An execution package consisting of a run and a function that returns a LocalDef001 forward-analysis certificate for every pair MR, MRinv satisfying the two-sided inverse condition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the principal hypothesis. Its run supplies all stored data, and its analysis function supplies the certificate used for each universally quantified inverse pair.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The forwardAnalysis field of an execution: given MR, MRinv and proof that they are mutual inverses, it returns a LocalDef001 certificate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target invokes this field before defining the coefficient used in the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run field of an execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All dimensions, matrices, vectors, error parameters, spectra and polynomial data in the proposition are obtained from this run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: For square real matrices A and Ainv, this is ||Ainv||_F ||A||_F, the product of their Frobenius norms.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the condition-like factors for MR and MRinv and for the composite pair MLinv A MRinv and MR Ainv ML.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a filter l and scalar functions scale, lhs and rhs, it asserts that there exists a scalar remainder r with r = O(scale^2) along l and, eventually along l, lhs(t) <= rhs(t) + |r(t)|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the final error-bound relation asserted for every inverse pair MR, MRinv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: For vectors x and xHat, it is ||xHat - x||_2 / ||x||_2, where ||.||_2 is the Euclidean norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the relative forward error used as the left-hand side of LocalDef016.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: For square matrices A and Ainv, it asserts Ainv(Ax) = x and A(Ainv x) = x for every vector x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts the universal matrices MR and MRinv to exact two-sided inverse pairs and also describes the inverse assumptions stored for A, Ainv, ML and MLinv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: If c has degrees degreeN and degreeK and coefficients c_ij, it evaluates the bivariate polynomial p(n,k) = sum_{i=0}^{degreeN} sum_{j=0}^{degreeK} c_ij n^i k^j over the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The value p(n,k) is the dimension-dependent polynomial factor multiplying the first-order bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The total error scale eta(t) = epsilonC(t) + epsilonB(t) + ug(t) + epsilonX(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The scalar remainder in the conclusion is Big-O of eta(t)^2 along l.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: The square matrix P = MR (Ainv ML).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Frobenius norm contributes to the outer composite condition factor in the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: The square matrix Q = MLinv (A MRinv).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Frobenius norm enters the outer composite condition factor and appears as a denominator in the alpha and beta coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: The scalar q(t) = alpha(t) epsilonC(t) + beta(t) epsilonB(t) + beta(t) ug(t) + lambda epsilonX(t), where alpha is LocalDef043, beta is LocalDef044 and lambda is LocalDef046.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The principal right-hand side is p(n,k) q(t) multiplied by ||MR Ainv ML||_F ||MLinv A MRinv||_F.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a forward-analysis certificate. It requires spectral quantities; perturbation-propagation maps that vanish at zero; contributions induced by deltaC, deltaB, least-squares perturbations and deltaX; a decomposition xHat-xExact into four contributions plus a remainder; pointwise relative-norm bounds p K alpha epsilonC, p K beta epsilonB, p K beta ug and p K lambda epsilonX; and a normalized remainder that is O(eta^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These stored component estimates are the structural source of the combined first-order expression used by the target, although the target directly extracts only the quantities field.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: A run certificate containing the exact problem, computed quantities, perturbations, basis data, spectral certificates, smallness assumptions, dimensions and error-model hypotheses listed by constructor D059.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target's witness, eventual spectrum bounds, relative error, scale and all coefficient data are projections or derived quantities from this package.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: The n by n matrix A stored in the run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the exact equation A xExact = b, the exact projected matrix MLinv A V, and the composite matrices in the final coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: The n by n matrix Ainv stored as a two-sided inverse of A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in P = MR Ainv ML and in the encoded exact-problem assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: The n by n matrix ML stored in the run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the inverse partner of MLinv and appears in P = MR Ainv ML.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: The n by n matrix MLinv stored as a two-sided inverse of ML.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the exact projected matrix, the computed right-hand-side reference and Q = MLinv A MRinv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: The scalar error-parameter function epsilonB(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enters both eta(t) and the beta(t) epsilonB(t) term of q(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: The scalar error-parameter function epsilonC(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enters both eta(t) and the alpha(t) epsilonC(t) term of q(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: The scalar solution-error parameter epsilonX(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enters both eta(t) and the lambda epsilonX(t) term of q(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: The scalar least-squares or iteration error parameter ug(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enters both eta(t) and the beta(t) ug(t) term of q(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: A descriptor of a finite bivariate real polynomial, with two natural degrees and a rectangular array of nonnegative coefficients.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run stores one such descriptor and LocalDef019 evaluates it at the dimensions n and k.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient function c_ij of a polynomial descriptor, indexed by 0 <= i <= degreeN and 0 <= j <= degreeK.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These coefficients are summed in the polynomial factor p(n,k).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: The degree in the k-variable of a polynomial descriptor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the range of powers of k in p(n,k).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: The degree in the n-variable of a polynomial descriptor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the range of powers of n in p(n,k).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef038 m k is the type of m by k real matrices, represented as functions Fin m -> Fin k -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the dimensions of basis, projected, Hessenberg and perturbation matrices throughout the execution and analysis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certificate containing, for every t, a certified spectrum of MR V(t), with strictly positive sigmaMin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target's alpha and beta coefficients use this positive sigmaMin, selected through analysis.quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certified pair sigmaMin, sigmaMax for a matrix A: both are nonnegative, sigmaMin ||x||_2 <= ||Ax||_2 <= sigmaMax ||x||_2 for every x, and when the column dimension is positive each bound is attained by a unit vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact extremal-gain interpretation of all sigmaMin and sigmaMax fields used in the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: The execution constructor, taking a run and a function that supplies a forward-analysis certificate for every mutual-inverse pair MR, MRinv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It explains the strong universal analysis capability encoded by the execution hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef042 n is the type of real n-vectors, represented as functions Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the vector spaces for exact and computed solutions, right-hand sides, residuals and perturbation contributions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: With V(t) the run's basis, C(t) = MLinv A V(t), Q = MLinv A MRinv, s(t) = sigmaMin(MR V(t)) and kappaR = ||MRinv||_F ||MR||_F, it is alpha(t) = (kappaR/s(t)) (||C(t)||_F/||Q||_F).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It weights epsilonC(t) inside q(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: With the same notation, it is beta(t) = max(1, (||C(t)||_F/||Q||_F)/s(t)) kappaR.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It weights both epsilonB(t) and ug(t) inside q(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of a finite real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every matrix norm in the condition-like factors alpha, beta and K is specifically the Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: For P = MR Ainv ML and Q = MLinv A MRinv, it is lambda = 1/(||P||_F ||Q||_F).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It weights epsilonX(t) in q(t); q(t) is subsequently multiplied by the same norm product.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of an n by n real matrix by an n-vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines two-sided inverses, A xExact = b and several stored computed-quantity relations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: The weighted sum alpha epsilonC + beta epsilonB + beta ug + lambda epsilonX.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: LocalDef023 applies this formula pointwise to produce q(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: The filter-based asymptotic assertion remainder = O(scale^2) along l.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the second-order requirement on both the analysis certificate's normalized remainder and the scalar remainder in the final conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of an n by n real matrix A with an n by k real matrix B.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms C(t), MR V(t), P, Q and other exact or computed matrix products.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean norm ||x||_2 = sqrt(sum_i x_i^2) of a finite real vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the relative forward error, residual norms, perturbation bounds and certified singular-value inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: The basis field of a basis family: for each k and t it returns an n by k real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines V(t), the exact projected matrix C(t), MR V(t), and the reconstruction V(t)yHat(t).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: The basisFamily field stored in a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all basis matrices used by the exact, computed and forward-analysis quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: The perturbation deltaB(t) in computedB(t) = MLinv b + deltaB(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is part of the encoded run assumptions and induces the right-hand-side contribution in each forward-analysis certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: The perturbation deltaC(t) in computedC(t) = MLinv A V(t) + deltaC(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is part of the encoded run assumptions and induces the computation contribution in each forward-analysis certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: The solution perturbation deltaX(t) in xHat(t) = V(t)yHat(t) + deltaX(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It induces the solution contribution bounded by the epsilonX term in each forward-analysis certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: The n-vector least-squares perturbation leastSquaresDeltaB(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with leastSquaresDeltaC it induces the contribution bounded by the ug term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: The n by keyDimension least-squares perturbation leastSquaresDeltaC(t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with leastSquaresDeltaB it induces the contribution bounded by the ug term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run constructor. It requires n>0; mutual-inverse pairs A,Ainv and ML,MLinv; b!=0 and A xExact=b; a nested injective basis family; 0<keyDimension<=n; a nonnegative-coefficient polynomial; nonnegative epsilonC, epsilonB, ug, epsilonX tending to zero; relative perturbation models for computedC, computedB and xHat; an upper-Hessenberg Arnoldi-type relation using vHatNext and beta; a perturbed least-squares minimizer with columnwise ug bounds; small condition-scaled parameters for computedC, exact C and epsilonX; and a vHat spectrum controlled by a nonnegative orthogonality defect that is eventually at most 7/16.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These encoded assumptions ensure the dimension facts, provide all exact and computed quantities, and furnish the spectral-defect hypotheses from which the target's eventual 4/3 bounds arise.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: The polynomial-descriptor constructor from two degrees, coefficients c_ij and proofs that every c_ij is nonnegative.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures the stored polynomial factor has nonnegative coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: The spectral-quantities constructor from certified spectra of MR V(t), requiring sigmaMin(MR V(t))>0 for every t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It guarantees that the singular-value denominator in alpha and beta is strictly positive.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: The mrzSpectrum field of a LocalDef039 certificate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the certified spectrum of MR V(t) used in alpha and beta.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: The spectrum constructor from nonnegative sigmaMin and sigmaMax, global lower and upper Euclidean-norm gain inequalities, and unit-vector attainment of each bound when the column dimension is positive.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the spectrum fields genuine certified minimum and maximum singular gains rather than unconstrained labels.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exact projected matrix C(t) = MLinv A V(t), where V(t) is the run's basis at keyDimension.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Frobenius norm appears in alpha and beta and it is the reference matrix for computedC.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: The squared Euclidean norm sum_i x_i^2 of a finite real vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its square root is LocalDef051, the vector norm used throughout the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef066
dependency_coverage.meaning: A family of n by k basis matrices indexed by dimension k and parameter t, with injectivity and cross-dimension consistency supplied by its constructor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It organizes the basis matrices used in all projected and reconstruction quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef067
dependency_coverage.meaning: The augmented matrix [b,C] obtained by prepending vector b as column zero to matrix C.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the stored Arnoldi relation and columnwise least-squares perturbation bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef068
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extraction of a specified matrix column as a vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states the least-squares perturbation estimate separately for every column of the augmented matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef069
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that y minimizes the Euclidean residual: ||b-Ay||_2 <= ||b-Az||_2 for every competing vector z.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact least-squares optimality assumption imposed on yHat for the perturbed computed system.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef070
dependency_coverage.meaning: The upper-Hessenberg condition H_ij=0 whenever i>j+1 for a (k+1) by k matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains the Hessenberg matrix in the run's Arnoldi-type relation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef071
dependency_coverage.meaning: A small-parameter assertion: theta tends to zero along l and eventually satisfies 0<=theta(t)<1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run applies it to condition-scaled computed and exact perturbation parameters and to epsilonX.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef072
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a matrix A and a supplied minimum singular value, the ratio ||A||_F/sigmaMin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the condition-scaled smallness assumptions stored in the run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef073
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of an m by k real matrix by a k by q real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the right-hand side of the stored Arnoldi-type matrix relation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef074
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of an m by k real matrix by a k-vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines spectrum inequalities, least-squares residuals, basis reconstruction and basis injectivity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef075
dependency_coverage.meaning: The length-(k+1) vector beta e_0: its first coordinate is beta and every other coordinate is zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the first column of the small augmented matrix in the Arnoldi-type relation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef076
dependency_coverage.meaning: The basis-family constructor. It requires each basis matrix with k<=n to act injectively and requires basis(k,t) to agree with the first k columns of basis(k+1,t) whenever k<n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It encodes full column rank and nestedness of the basis matrices used by the run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef077
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that the linear map x -> Ax is injective.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the full-column-rank condition required of each admissible basis matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines equality, dimension, spectral and error-bound conclusions and combines hypotheses inside certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation supplied by a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides ordinary real division for reciprocal singular values, norm ratios and the rational constant 4/3.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states k=keyDimension and all exact inverse, decomposition and computation identities.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It quantifies the witness k and the scalar remainder in each second-order bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter
dependency_coverage.meaning: A filter on an index type, representing the notion of eventual behavior or limiting direction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It parameterizes every eventual, convergence and Big-O assertion.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.Eventually
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that a predicate holds on a set belonging to a filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the spectral inequalities and final error inequality asymptotic rather than pointwise for all t.

dependency_coverage.name: Filter.NeBot
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that the filter is not the bottom filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It prevents all eventual assertions from becoming automatically true merely because l is bottom.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Application of a heterogeneous division operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With real instances it denotes every quotient in the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Application of a heterogeneous multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With real instances it combines all scalar factors in the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Application of a less-than-or-equal relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses k<=n, the spectral upper bounds and all norm inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Application of a strict less-than relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses 0<k and the strict positivity or smallness assumptions in dependent certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: They index ambient and basis dimensions, polynomial degrees and finite coordinates.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof-producing instance that a nonzero natural's successor is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It only supports elaboration of real numeral literals such as 3 and 4 and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that every natural successor is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports numeral-instance construction and contributes no substantive proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of a natural-number literal in a target type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets 0 and the real constants 1, 3 and 4.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Construction of the numeral-one instance from a One operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the numerator 1 in reciprocal expressions the real number one.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: They are the scalar field for all matrices, vectors, norms, spectra, errors and constants.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplicative, inverse and division structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes all divisions as Lean's real division.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard order relation <= on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies every real inequality in the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Standard multiplication on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies multiplication in all scalar coefficients and bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard embedding of natural numbers into the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets n and k as real arguments of the polynomial factor and constructs real numerals.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative identity 1 in the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies reciprocal numerators and the first argument of max in beta.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous HDiv instance induced by an ordinary Div instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies heterogeneous real division notation with ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous HMul instance induced by an ordinary Mul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies heterogeneous real multiplication notation with ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instLENat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard <= relation on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact dimension restriction k<=n.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard < relation on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact positivity restriction 0<k.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: Construction of a numeral instance from a natural-number cast for literals at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the real literals 3 and 4 without adding a mathematical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical interpretation of each natural literal as itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the natural literals used in dimensions and numeral-instance proofs.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite index type {0,...,n-1}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes all finite vectors, matrix rows, matrix columns and polynomial coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite enumeration structure on Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits sums over all vector coordinates, matrix contraction indices and polynomial coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-number value of a finite index.

binders: n is an implicit natural number giving the ambient vector and square-matrix dimension.
ι is an arbitrary index type, l is a filter on ι, and l is assumed nonbottom.
execution is a LocalDef012 execution package over l; write run for execution.run and k0 for run.keyDimension.
The conclusion existentially selects k. Inside its last conjunct, MR and MRinv range universally over n by n real matrices, subject to being mutual inverses.
For each admissible pair MR, MRinv, the remainder asserted by LocalDef016 is existentially chosen after that pair and may therefore depend on MR, MRinv and their supplied analysis certificate.
hypotheses: The execution's run encodes n>0; n by n real matrices A,Ainv,ML,MLinv with Ainv and MLinv exact two-sided inverses of A and ML; vectors b and xExact with b nonzero and A xExact=b; and a stored dimension k0 satisfying 0<k0<=n.
The run contains a nested family V_k(t) of n by k matrices whose matrix-vector maps are injective whenever k<=n, together with a bivariate polynomial descriptor having nonnegative coefficients.

The functions epsilonC, epsilonB, ug and epsilonX are pointwise nonnegative and each tends to zero along l. The run contains computedC=C+deltaC with ||deltaC||_F<=epsilonC||C||_F, where C=MLinv A V_k0; and computedB=MLinv b+deltaB with ||deltaB||_2<=epsilonB||MLinv b||_2.

The run contains vHat, vHatNext, beta and an upper-Hessenberg matrix H satisfying the augmented relation [computedB,computedC]=vHatNext[beta e_0,H], with vHat equal to the first k0 columns of vHatNext.

The run contains perturbations leastSquaresDeltaB and leastSquaresDeltaC and a vector yHat that globally minimizes the Euclidean residual for the perturbed pair computedC+leastSquaresDeltaC and computedB+leastSquaresDeltaB. Every column of the augmented least-squares perturbation is bounded by p(n,k0) ug times the norm of the corresponding computed augmented column.

The computed and exact projected matrices have supplied spectrum certificates and satisfy the encoded condition-scaled smallness assumptions. The computed solution obeys xHat=V_k0 yHat+deltaX with ||deltaX||_2<=epsilonX||V_k0 yHat||_2, and epsilonX also satisfies the stronger small-parameter condition of tending to zero and eventually lying in [0,1).
The run contains a certified spectrum for vHat and a nonnegative orthogonality defect d(t), eventually d(t)<=7/16, with 1-d(t)<=sigma_min(vHat(t))^2 and sigma_max(vHat(t))^2<=1+d(t) for every t.

For every mutual-inverse pair MR,MRinv, execution.forwardAnalysis supplies a certificate with a strictly positive certified sigma_min(MR V_k0(t)), a decomposition of xHat-xExact into perturbation contributions and a remainder, the four stated first-order relative-norm bounds, and a normalized remainder that is O((epsilonC+epsilonB+ug+epsilonX)^2) along l.
conclusions: There exists a natural number k such that k=k0, 0<k and k<=n.
Eventually along l, both 1/sigma_min(vHat(t))<=4/3 and sigma_max(vHat(t))<=4/3 hold.

For every n by n real mutual-inverse pair MR,MRinv, let the supplied forward analysis determine a certified spectrum of MR V_k(t). Then there exists a scalar function r_{MR,MRinv}(t) with r_{MR,MRinv}=O(eta^2) along l such that eventually ||xHat(t)-xExact||_2/||xExact||_2 <= p(n,k) K [alpha(t)epsilonC(t)+beta(t)epsilonB(t)+beta(t)ug(t)+K^{-1}epsilonX(t)] + |r_{MR,MRinv}(t)|.
mathematical_definitions: For a vector x in R^m, ||x||_2=sqrt(sum_i x_i^2). For a real matrix B, ||B||_F is its Frobenius norm.
Let V(t)=run.basisFamily.basis(k,t), C(t)=MLinv A V(t), S(t)=MR V(t), Q=MLinv A MRinv and P=MR Ainv ML.

The spectrum certificates define sigma_min(B) and sigma_max(B) by the inequalities sigma_min(B)||x||_2<=||Bx||_2<=sigma_max(B)||x||_2 for all x, with nonnegative bounds and unit-vector attainment when the column dimension is positive.
If the polynomial descriptor has coefficients c_ij and degrees dN,dK, then p(n,k)=sum_{i=0}^{dN}sum_{j=0}^{dK}c_ij n^i k^j, with n and k interpreted as real numbers.
Let s(t)=sigma_min(S(t)) from analysis.quantities. This value is certified strictly positive.
The final LocalDef016 assertion is exactly: there exists r with r=O(eta^2) along l and eventually E(t)<=p(n,k)q(t)K+|r(t)|.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every nonbottom filter and every execution package carrying the exact problem, computed quantities, perturbation model, spectral data and forward analyses described above, the run's stored basis dimension k0 can be chosen as a witness k with 0<k<=n. Eventually along the filter, the certified computed-basis singular gains satisfy 1/sigma_min(vHat(t))<=4/3 and sigma_max(vHat(t))<=4/3. Moreover, for every exact two-sided inverse pair MR,MRinv, the relative Euclidean forward error of xHat is eventually bounded by the nonnegative-coefficient polynomial p(n,k), multiplied by the composite Frobenius condition factor K and the explicit weighted first-order error expression q(t), plus the absolute value of a remainder that is Big-O of the square of the total error scale eta(t).

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: All eventual, convergence and Big-O statements are relative to the arbitrary filter l; they are not assertions for every t.
The nonbottom assumption prevents triviality caused by the bottom filter, but it does not turn an eventual assertion into a uniform pointwise assertion or specify a numerical threshold.
Under the supplied run constructor an execution includes a proof n>0. Thus the outer universal proposition is vacuous for n=0 because no such execution can be constructed from that constructor.
The existential k has no freedom: it is explicitly required to equal the run's stored keyDimension.
The final remainder is chosen inside the universal quantification over MR,MRinv, so neither the remainder nor its implicit Big-O constant is asserted to be uniform over inverse pairs.
The universal conclusion applies only when MR and MRinv satisfy both exact inverse identities; no approximate inverse pair is covered.
Matrix condition-like quantities use products of Frobenius norms, not spectral/operator 2-norm condition numbers.

Lean real division is total, so a displayed quotient alone would not rule out a zero denominator. Here the analysis certificate explicitly gives sigma_min(MR V(t))>0; b!=0 and A xExact=b with invertible A imply xExact!=0; and the encoded invertibility assumptions make the composite matrices nonzero in the positive-dimensional setting. The target's isolated inequality 1/sigma_min(vHat)<=4/3 should nevertheless be read literally, with eventual positivity supplied indirectly by the stored defect hypotheses.
The conclusion is an upper bound E<=first-order expression+|remainder|, not an asymptotic equality and not a componentwise error bound.

The execution hypothesis is strong: it already contains decomposition maps, component estimates, spectral certificates and second-order remainder control for every inverse pair. The proposition does not derive these from an independently encoded implementation.
No probability model, stochastic claim, hardware floating-point semantics, convergence rate, optimality of 4/3, or tightness of the polynomial factor is asserted.
The spectrum objects are characterized axiomatically by norm inequalities and attainment; the proposition does not encode a particular singular-value computation algorithm.
